info.title: vertice-bff
info.description:
The REST API the Vertice web and mobile apps call; it bridges HTTP/JSON to vertice-api over gRPC.

Every error is `{ error: { code, message, details? } }`: key on `code`, never on `message`. Besides the errors listed per operation, any call can answer 429 (global rate limit), 502 `UPSTREAM_ERROR` or 503 `UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE` (vertice-api refused or is down). Rules that do not fit a schema (ownership, rate limits, the time-zone rule) are in docs/api-contract.md.

bearerAuth.description: The token `POST /api/auth/login` or `/api/auth/register` returned. Treat it as opaque.

startDate.description: Business date, `YYYY-MM-DD`: a calendar day in America/Sao_Paulo, with no time and no zone. Never put it through a UTC conversion — `new Date("2026-10-31")` is UTC midnight, which renders as 30/10/2026 in Brazil.

endDate.description: Business date, `YYYY-MM-DD`: a calendar day in America/Sao_Paulo, with no time and no zone. Never put it through a UTC conversion — `new Date("2026-10-31")` is UTC midnight, which renders as 30/10/2026 in Brazil.

anyOf.description: ISO-8601 instant, UTC (`Z`). An absolute point in time. Format it for display in a time zone (the business zone is America/Sao_Paulo) — never read the clock or the calendar day off the string, and never assume a fixed -03:00 (instants from before 2019 are -02:00).

time.description: DEPRECATED, use `completedAt`. The `HH:MM` wall clock of the completion in America/Sao_Paulo — a pre-formatted local time, with the zone implicit, which is why it is going away. It is kept only so clients can migrate: it used to be the UTC clock (`completedAt.slice(11, 16)`), which displayed an evening workout about 3 hours early, and it now reads correctly. It will be removed once vertice-web-react reads `completedAt`.

completedAt.description: When the workout was completed, as an ISO-8601 instant in UTC (`Z`). Prefer this over the deprecated `time`: format the clock in America/Sao_Paulo (`Intl.DateTimeFormat` with `timeZone`), e.g. 20:30. "Today" is still the server's: the entries are the completions whose business day in America/Sao_Paulo is today.

profile.description: CPF and CREF in full: it is the user’s own copy.

text.description: `""` when the client only rated the workout.

rating.description: Null on feedback given before ratings existed.

replaced.description: The session was replaced by a redo finished in the same week.

code.description: Machine-readable. Key on this, never on `message`.

message.description: English, for logs and debugging; not meant to be shown to users.

details.description: Only on the BFF’s own validation errors (`VALIDATION_ERROR`): Zod’s flattened field errors, `{ formErrors: string[], fieldErrors: { [field]: string[] } }`. Never set from upstream.

muscleGroups.description: Upstream order: primary group first, then the others by id.

isStarter.description: Part of the shared, read-only starter set.

weight.description: Decimal string; `""` is unset. Do not round-trip through a float.

put.description: Roles: TRAINER. On their own plan. Full replace, not merge: `[]` empties the workout. All or nothing.
